verdict.rationale: Box documents a dedicated Events API that lets applications subscribe to enterprise-wide user actions in real time or query historical event logs, effectively serving as an audit trail accessible via documented API (box-docs-8, box-docs-19). This supports SIEM-style export/integration use cases via API access with OAuth (box-docs-1). Missing for 10: no explicit mention of a native SIEM connector/integration or retention policy details, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of enterprise audit log completeness.
